defects.root_cause: Probability-consumed rich fields could override the scalar Statcast profile without preserving player identity, target date, source cutoff, source hash, counts, denominator, fallback reason, or a hash of the effective value.
defects.repair: Every active shared-PA rich override now carries versioned field lineage. Direct Statcast fields must equal their bound profile values; contact-adapter and active rolling fields require independent lineage. Identity, chronology, source, value, and denominator contradictions terminate at serialization and probability consumption.

defects.root_cause: The shared batter feature artifact did not carry source hashes and cutoff lineage uniformly from Statcast rows through effective probability inputs.
defects.repair: Statcast profiles now bind the exact consumed rows to an order-invariant SHA-256, source maximum date, and requested cutoff. The fields persist through feature-store serialization and appear in automatic input-health records.

defects.root_cause: The fitted hitter K/BB bridge could use current season/last-X snapshots during historical reconstruction, overwrite league fallback values without updating lineage, and silently convert a point-in-time source failure to missing data.
defects.repair: A separately selectable point_in_time_required mode now accepts only strict prior-game logs with per-field player/date/hash/count/denominator lineage. Source loss terminates. A simulator gate requires this lineage whenever a new fitted-K/BB candidate elects strict mode. The legacy path remains only as a frozen comparator.

reconstruction.reason: This repair adds strict provenance and failure boundaries without changing a valid input value or coefficient. Rebuilding spent historical features would create no independent performance evidence.

mutation_proof: row and column order cannot change a Statcast source hash
a source value mutation changes its source hash
a rich value mutation cannot retain its old lineage hash
re-hashing a direct override cannot make it differ from the bound profile
cross-player, same-day cutoff, source-hash, and denominator mutations terminate
active rolling xwOBA without source lineage terminates
hitter K/BB identity, cutoff, source-hash, numerator, and denominator mutations terminate
point-in-time game-log transport failure cannot become missing player data
missing or malformed point-in-time game-log schema cannot become an empty valid history
May is rejected before a point-in-time game-log source call
verification.numeric_non_regression: For identical valid values, probabilities are exactly equal with lineage enforcement enabled or disabled for both rich Statcast inputs and fitted hitter K/BB inputs.

hashes.data_feature_hash_reason: No model data or feature artifact was rebuilt because no valid-path probability changed.

promotion.reason: Integrity correctness and numerical inertness are proven, but no fresh independent proper-score or market evidence exists.

single_highest_value_next_action: Deploy and independently verify the receipt-only AWS T-minus-4 probable-starter collector for the next future slate. It cannot repair missed dates, does not change probabilities, and is required before any pitcher-matchup candidate can be admissible.
